baseline_train_partition: V18 frozen clustered train only; no refit on CV, old test, or new test

bootstrap.draw: sample K cluster indices uniformly with replacement per replicate, K = observed cluster count
bootstrap.seed_handling: average error sums over fixed checkpoints per sequence before resampling; use same cluster draw for model and median baseline
bootstrap.support_rule: primary contrast ci_lower > 0; otherwise superiority is not established

checkpoint_policy: Reuse exactly these three V18 clustered checkpoints; no refit, seed selection, ensembling or test-driven changes.

cohort_design.profile_key: source SHA-256 plus zero-based data row ordinal, excluding header
cohort_design.profiles: all eligible rows for selected sequences, including legitimate repeated assay profiles
cohort_design.sequence_ranking: ascending (sha256(UTF8(sequence_ranking_prefix + sequence)), sha256(UTF8(sequence))) using lowercase hexadecimal digests
cohort_design.take: first 1000 after complete development and qualifying-neighbour exclusion

exposure_registry.required_scope: all sequences ever used for fitting, validation, testing or inspected prediction/error during development; includes all V17/V18 1000 sequences, V9/V10 OLD cohorts and earlier runs

failure_policy: Any missing required artifact, hash/version mismatch, incomplete exposure history, command/search failure, incomplete direction, qualifying cross-boundary hit, sample-size/coverage floor failure, invalid target after lock, or prior test exposure blocks evaluation. Never relax thresholds, silently replace sequences, or fill in missing metrics.
feature_policy: ViennaRNA 2.7.2 RNA.md() defaults and RNA.OPTION_MFE, no constraints; capture all scalar model details and structure outputs before target access; use reviewed feature implementation

metric_definition.clipping: both predictions and finite targets clipped to [0, 1]
metric_definition.inference: model.eval(), no gradient, padding-safe forward as in reviewed code; non-finite measured predictions fail evaluation
metric_definition.mask: finite observed targets within sequence length in the profile assay channel; missing positions and other assay channel excluded

primary_contrast: train-only assay-median MAE minus primary model MAE; positive favours model
primary_metric: Arithmetic mean of three seed-specific nucleotide-weighted clipped test MAEs; not MAE of averaged predictions
research_question: Does the frozen V18 real-ViennaRNA predictor outperform the frozen train-only assay-median baseline on new, development-excluded RNA sequences?
selection_metric: mean across seeds of nucleotide-weighted clipped CV MAE

similarity.bootstrap_cluster_definition: connected components of qualifying selected-test all-vs-all nucleotide hits; include singleton sequences; canonical sorted-member digest ID
similarity.claim_limit: no detected qualifying forward-strand hit under the recorded procedure; not universally homology-free
similarity.cluster_id: sha256(UTF8(concatenation of sorted member sequence digests, each followed by one LF))
similarity.max_seqs_rule: max(300, number of target sequences) in each directed search
required_searches: six directions among frozen V18 train, CV and new test

source.version_identity: SHA256-pinned corrected current snapshot; no invented upstream version number
